description_en: Re-evaluates the compliance of resources based on a rule or based on all rules in a compliance package in a specific account group
description_zh: 重新审计指定账号组内的某条规则或某个合规包中的所有规则
name: StartAggregateConfigRuleEvaluation

parameters.help_en:
The rule ID.

For more information about how to query the ID of a rule, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html.

You must configure either the `CompliancePackId` or `ConfigRuleId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264148.html。

参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to re-evaluate the ignored non-compliant resource. Valid values:

true: re-evaluates the ignored non-compliant resource based on the rule.
false (default): does not re-evaluate the ignored non-compliant resource based on the rule
parameters.help_zh:
是否恢复已忽略的评估结果。取值：

true：恢复已忽略的评估结果。

false（默认值）：不恢复已忽略的评估结果
parameters.name: revert_evaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a compliance package, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html.

You must configure either the `CompliancePackId` or `ConfigRuleId` parameter
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html。

参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the involved resources were evaluated. Valid values:

true: The involved resources were evaluated.
false: The involved resources were not evaluated
Result.description_zh:
规则执行结果。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
